ja229:1.1: With clouds of great elephants, with garlanded great horses,
ja229:1.2: With a wave of chariots, with a great rain of arrows,
ja229:1.3: With the whirlpool of weapon-handlers giving them strong blows,
ja229:1.4: Beseiging (the great city of) Taxila on all sides.
ja229:2.1: Run up against them, approach them quickly,
ja229:2.2: With the sounding of various noises,
ja229:2.3: Continue the great sound today, just as
ja229:2.4: With lightning flashes, the rain cloud thunders.
